name: K-C Paris Plant - Paris TX
type: Diaper / personal care manufacturing plant (Huggies, Pull-Ups, Little Swimmers, Goodnites)

fieldNotes.location: Roster supplied only a city-level address and a coordinate that landed in downtown Paris (~5 km off). Web research (Paris TX Chamber, Texas TDLR project record, Yelp) confirmed the address as 2466 Farm Road 137 (FM 137), Paris, TX 75460 — K-C's 238-acre Huggies diaper/personal-care plant off SW Loop 286. Identified the building by scanning SW Paris industrial sites: the matching facility is a large enclosed manufacturing complex with employee parking, a circular entrance drive, and a large trailer drop yard at ~33.6389,-95.5912. Several other unrelated industrial sites (a lumber/scrap yard, slab/construction site) were ruled out.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The access road from SW Loop 286 splits into separate inbound/outbound lanes at a pinch-point near the building (~33.6396,-95.5904). The site is perimeter-fenced (chain-link visible in Street View). Small structures/posts cross the lanes at the pinch-point — classed truckGate true, but a hard barrier could not be fully resolved; listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small structure with a canopy sits beside the entry road at the pinch-point but cannot be positively confirmed as a staffed guard booth at z20-21. Classed guardShack false / remoteGs true as best estimate.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: The entry road clearly forks into two separate paved lanes approaching the plant — classed entry/exit separate; listed uncertain as it could be a single divided drive.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large trailer drop yard SW of the building with multiple long rows of parked trailers — 50+.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock bank on the building's south/SW face with trailers backed in; ~40 doors estimated from z18-20 imagery — listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible entering the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Plant sits on a large wooded/field parcel off SW Loop 286 on the edge of Paris — rural per the tie-break rule.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entry apron and the forked entry lanes leave room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: One main manufacturing building with attached/adjacent structures (utility/support buildings) — treated as a single facility, not a multi-cluster campus.

citations.claim: Active K-C careers requisition (Site Leader, Environmental & Sustainability) at the Paris Plant, Paris TX.

verification.rationale: Multiple active K-C careers reqs name the Paris Plant; survived the 2018 restructuring rumors; no closure/sale/WARN evidence for Paris TX.
